findings.currentTarget: Nun: Na yangu yanaonyesha kukataliwa tu…
findings.proposedFullTarget: Nun: Na yangu inaonyesha kukataliwa tu…
findings.objectiveReason: мои refers to mikono (class 4 plural), not class 6. The predicate needs inaonyesha instead of yanaonyesha.

findings.currentTarget: Nun: Hiyo ndiyo kumbukumbu yenu. Hakuna wanachosema, lakini unasikiliza kama punda aliyedanganywa…

findings.objectiveReason: они refers to the photographs retained after people die, explicitly picha/N10 in the preceding units. Hakuna wanachosema uses human plural reference and loses the assertion that the photographs say nothing.
